claims.statement: Joint finite-ray initialization for every fixed k<=d orthonormal input set: stable F, positive-stable C, marked output-weight endpoint PPP with independent primitives; C positive definite and F has full-dimensional density.

Sensitivity D_b J is invertible after every regular irreversible positive diagonal deletion, by a strictly decreasing quadratic energy; Sard then excludes all-phase grazing and simultaneous returns for almost every b.
